name: @depegprotocol/mcp-server

tools.name: depeg_find_pool
tools.description: Look up a DEPEG pool's full state — config (fee split, paused, mints, vaults) and staking pool (total staked, total effective stake, accumulator) — for a given pump.fun coin mint. Returns null fields if the pool doesn't exist.

coinMint.description: Base58 pubkey of the pump.fun coin mint

tools.name: depeg_list_pools
tools.description: Enumerate every DEPEG pool on the chosen cluster. Returns the Config of each pool (admin, creator, mints, fee split). Use this to discover what coins have been wrapped.

tools.name: depeg_get_user_positions
tools.description: Returns every StakePosition the user owns in this coin's pool. Each position has amount (raw 6-decimal stablecoin), lock_period, locked_until (unix), and effective_stake.

tools.name: depeg_get_pending_rewards
tools.description: Client-side calc of pending rewards for one StakePosition. Applies the user's active booster (if any). Returns raw u64; divide by 1e6 to get stablecoin units.

positionId.description: u64 position id as a decimal or hex string

tools.name: depeg_swap_usdc_to_stablecoin
tools.description: Deposit USDC into a DEPEG pool's USDC vault, receive freshly-minted stablecoin 1:1. Caller's stablecoin ATA is created idempotently. Requires a wallet.

amount.description: Raw USDC u64 (6 decimals; e.g. '1000000' = 1 USDC)

tools.name: depeg_swap_stablecoin_to_usdc
tools.description: Burn stablecoin, withdraw USDC 1:1. Caller's USDC ATA is created idempotently. Rejects on-chain if the pool's USDC vault is empty.

tools.name: depeg_stake
tools.description: Lock stablecoin into the staking vault for the chosen period. Effective stake = amount × lock_boost / 10000. Min 1 stablecoin (1_000_000 raw). Max 4 positions per user per pool. `position_id` is caller-chosen u64; collision fails.

lockPeriod.description: Lock period — longer = higher reward multiplier (oneYear ≈ 6,975×).

positionId.description: Caller-chosen u64. Defaults to current millis-epoch.

tools.name: depeg_claim_rewards
tools.description: Settles + transfers pending stablecoin rewards. Principal remains staked.

tools.name: depeg_unstake
tools.description: Withdraw principal + claim pending rewards. Rejects with StillLocked on-chain if the lock period hasn't elapsed. Closes the position account; rent refunded to owner.

tools.name: depeg_buy_booster
tools.description: Pay SOL into the buyback vault, activate a 7-day boost on every position in this pool. Replaces any prior boost. Tier 0..5 maps to 1.25× / 1.5× / 1.75× / 2× / 2.5× / 3×. ALL of the user's positions in this pool must be provided in `positions` (writable).

positionIds.description: All u64 position IDs the user holds in this pool. Length MUST equal UserPoolState.positionCount.

tools.name: depeg_launch_pool
tools.description:
ATOMIC LAUNCH: creates a brand-new pump.fun coin (mint + bonding curve via create_v2) AND wraps it as a DEPEG pool (stablecoin mint + USDC vault + staking pool) in a single transaction. Pump.fun creator fees route to DEPEG's on-chain distribution PDA; the launching wallet receives the creator share of every pump.fun trade on the new coin, alongside DEPEG protocol fees from stablecoin swaps.

The launch is co-signed by DEPEG's platform admin via https://depeg.app's /api/co-sign-launch endpoint (the agent never holds admin keys). Agents that set DEPEG_AGENT_FLOW=1 (default for the MCP server) get the 5 USDC pool seed covered by the protocol for the first 25 launches — pay only ~0.005 SOL gas.

coinName.description: Display name for the new pump.fun coin

coinSymbol.description: Ticker for the new pump.fun coin (uppercase recommended)

coinUri.description: URI to Metaplex JSON metadata for the pump.fun coin

stablecoinName.description: Display name for the paired DEPEG stablecoin

stablecoinSymbol.description: Ticker for the paired DEPEG stablecoin (e.g. 'sMEME')

stablecoinUri.description: URI to Metaplex JSON metadata for the stablecoin

vaultBps.description: Trade-fee bps routed to the USDC vault (>=500, default 4000)

stakingBps.description: Trade-fee bps routed to stakers (>=500, default 4000)

seedUsdc.description: Raw USDC u64; defaults to 5_000_000 (5 USDC). Lower values rejected by program.
